content.thinking:
I'm working out the notice period: tenants need to give two months' notice, so with the email served on 10 October, the earliest valid end date would be 10 December 2026 — I need to check how this interacts with the periodic monthly tenancy terms and rent due dates under the Act.

Earlier ending would need landlord's written agreement to a shorter date or a surrender agreement. I shouldn't promise anything about deposit timing or key drop-off — just confirm deposit returns go through the scheme within 10 days post-tenancy with deductions via checkout, and that key arrangements will be confirmed separately. I'll request landlord approval for early surrender while sending the tenant a reply, rather than escalating to a human since this doesn't seem to require it.

arguments.body: Hi Tom, thanks for letting us know, and good luck with the new job. Since 1 May 2026 tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough on its own. Your notice, received 10 October, would end the tenancy on 10 December 2026 at the earliest. You can leave earlier only if your landlord agrees in writing. I'm asking him now whether he will agree to 10 November, and I'll tell you his answer by Wednesday 14 October. Please keep paying rent as normal until an end date is agreed in writing. On keys and your deposit: I'll confirm the key hand-back arrangements once the end date is settled. Your deposit is held in the mydeposits scheme and is returned after you leave, once the final check of the flat is done. I can't give a firm date or amount yet. Kind regards, Mare & Co Lettings

arguments.decision_needed: Tenant Tom Achterberg (Flat 2, 5 Navarino Road) gave one month's notice by email on 10 Oct to leave on 10 Nov. Legally two months applies, so the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026. Do you agree in writing to an earlier end date of 10 Nov 2026? Reply by Wed 14 Oct please.
options: Agree in writing to end on 10 November 2026 (we then arrange check-out, keys and deposit)
Hold to two months: tenancy ends 10 December 2026
Suggest a different date between the two

arguments.purpose: Chase landlord Ben Hartley for decision on early end date for Tom Achterberg tenancy; then update tenant
